answer_1.quote: We frame this task as a generative evaluation task in which a model outputs a ranked list of answers to a given question.

answer_2.quote: We propose two different metrics, one similar to hits@k in traditional information retrieval task and one which limits the number of incorrect answers...

answer_4.quote: To measure human performance against such models, we collected 30 additional human responses per question with the same setup in collecting test data and aggregated them by counts...
